clue.text: It enables one to go straight-even after a vodka perhaps!

definitions.text: It enables one to go straight

indicators.note: the word for even is placed after the vodka piece in the charade

parts.note: vodka is one example of a spirit, signalled by 'perhaps'
even means flat, level

explanation.surface: A joke that a stiff vodka helps someone walk straight.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests drunkenness, but the vodka is just an example of a spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: A builder's bubble gauge shows whether a surface is truly horizontal, letting work proceed straight.

clue.text: She's glad she got a high score

definitions.text: She's glad she got a high score

parts.words: She's glad she got a high score
parts.note: reads as someone pleased with a good mark, but the score is a musical one and the singer's part is pitched high

explanation.surface: A woman is pleased with her high mark in a test.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest female singing voice takes the top line of a musical score.

clue.text: On being taken from the Red Lion in a dishevelled state, he refuses to work

indicators.note: dishevelled means messed up, so the remaining letters are rearranged
the word on is removed from the letters of the pub name that follows

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A scruffy man thrown out of the Red Lion pub is a layabout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being taken from' removes ON from REDLION, leaving REDLI; 'in a dishevelled state' rearranges those letters. The Red Lion is a common British pub name.
explanation.definitionFit: A loafer or slacker is someone who avoids labour.

clue.text: While on a camping holiday, no one comes back on purpose

parts.note: someone camping is sleeping in a tent

indicators.note: the pieces for no and one are read in reverse order and direction

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Nobody returns from a camping trip deliberately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes back' turns NOI into ION, placed after IN TENT.
explanation.definitionFit: An aim or plan someone means to carry out is their purpose.

clue.text: Add spirit! It's 50 to one

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
an ace counts as one in cards

explanation.surface: Someone urges adding liquor, quoting long betting odds.
explanation.walkthrough: '50 to one' looks like betting odds; it is simply L followed by ACE.
explanation.definitionFit: To lace a drink is to spike it with a little liquor.

clue.text: Upheavals in which aluminium, sulphur and vanadium are released with oxygen, carbon monoxide and nitrogen

indicators.note: the chemical symbols are freed from their order and rearranged

parts.note: Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium
S is the chemical symbol for sulphur
V is the chemical symbol for vanadium
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen
CO is the chemical formula for carbon monoxide
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: Eruptions that release metals and gases into the air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'released' rearranges the symbols AL, S, V, O, CO and N.
explanation.definitionFit: Eruptions of lava and gas are violent upheavals of the earth's crust.

clue.text: Angry when 6 hide in cover

indicators.note: the numeral is concealed inside the word for a cover

parts.note: a lid is a cover
VI is the Roman numeral for six

explanation.surface: Six people sulk under a blanket when cross.
explanation.definitionFit: Livid is a strong word for furious.

clue.text: Gets comfortable on old seats

explanation.surface: Someone sinks into antique chairs.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle is to make oneself at ease; a settle is a high-backed wooden bench of old.

clue.text: A large number experience dreamlike state despite loud ringing noise

annotationWithheld.why: A large number experience dreamlike state despite loud ringing noise (8): C + LANGOUR needs 'dreamlike state' to give LANGOUR, but languor is spelt LANGUOR; no parse found and no blog confirms the setter's intent
annotationWithheld.clue: A large number experience dreamlike state despite loud ringing noise

clue.text: Demonstrates cunning concerning the party

explanation.surface: A party member shows craftiness.
explanation.definitionFit: Being shrewd and scheming is called playing politics; party matters belong to politics.

clue.text: Groom gives animal doctor about a pound

indicators.note: the doctor's word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: a vet treats animals
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from libra

explanation.surface: A horse groom pays the vet roughly a pound.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentleman's personal attendant, like a groom, is a manservant.

clue.text: Going public with a song about gin

parts.note: an air is a tune or song

indicators.note: about here means in a different arrangement, so the letters of gin are mixed

explanation.surface: Someone sings a ballad in praise of gin in public.
explanation.definitionFit: Airing views is making them known openly.

clue.text: Laird can become a high churchman

indicators.note: the letters of the two words turn into something else

explanation.surface: A Scottish landowner may rise to senior church office.
explanation.walkthrough: A laird is a Scottish landowner.
explanation.definitionFit: A prince of the Catholic Church ranks just below the Pope.

clue.text: Had an expensive flower-or got told off!

parts.note: taken as written
chid is an old past tense of chide, to scold

explanation.surface: Someone either bought a pricey bloom or got a scolding.
explanation.definitionFit: Exotic orchids are prized and often costly blooms.

clue.text: It's very hard to study on a Greek island

indicators.note: in a down clue the study piece sits on top of the island

parts.note: to con is to study or learn
Crete is the largest Greek island

explanation.surface: Studying on holiday in Greece is tough.
explanation.definitionFit: Set cement mix forms a building material that is extremely solid.

clue.text: Deep sounding issue or nothing we object to

parts.note: issue means offspring, such as a son
taken as written
O is the round figure zero
us is the object form of we

explanation.surface: Someone complains about a child or about nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we object' means the object case of we, not a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: A resonant, booming voice is rich and full in tone.

clue.text: Trip to tea shop for someone to treat one's back!

indicators.note: tripping means stumbling, so the letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: Going out to a tearoom to find a back specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: This practitioner manipulates bones and muscles, often to relieve spinal pain.

clue.text: The little monkey came with open arms to me!

indicators.note: opened up, the letters are spread out and rearranged

explanation.surface: A small primate rushes to be hugged.
explanation.definitionFit: This small South American primate has silky fur and a long tail.

clue.text: Sharp tool noticed after net was thrown

indicators.note: thrown means tossed about, so the letters of net are mixed

parts.note: on can mean immediately after, as in payment on delivery
saw means noticed

explanation.surface: A blade spotted once the fishing net was cast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was thrown' gives TEN from NET; 'after' supplies ON, a loose but known equivalence.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine-toothed carpenter's hand blade is used for cutting joints.

clue.text: To correspond completely

parts.note: taken as written
to tally is to agree or correspond

explanation.surface: An instruction to match up fully.
explanation.definitionFit: Wholly or entirely, with nothing left out.

clue.text: Looks hard because it sounds like a long flight

indicators.note: the word heard aloud is matched with one spelt differently

parts.note: a long flight of steps is stairs

explanation.surface: Someone gazes intently at a long journey by air.
explanation.definitionFit: To gaze fixedly at something is to gawp or glare.

clue.text: Frank is very honest

explanation.surface: A man named Frank is truthful.
explanation.definitionFit: Candid and genuine both describe an open, truthful person.

clue.text: Annoying enough to weary a few

parts.note: to tire is to weary
some means a few

explanation.surface: A handful of people are enough to wear anyone out.
explanation.definitionFit: Tedious and irksome things wear one down.

clue.text: Concerned with sound or counterfeit coins

indicators.note: counterfeit means faked, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A question of noise or forged money.
explanation.definitionFit: Acoustic matters relate to audible waves.

clue.text: Liquid whose preparation requires no toil

indicators.note: a preparation is something made up, so the letters are made up anew

explanation.surface: A liquid easily made without effort.
explanation.definitionFit: A skin cream or medicinal wash is a fluid preparation.

clue.text: Another country may help N. Ireland to rise up

indicators.note: in a down clue the pieces are read from bottom to top

parts.note: aid means help
NI is the abbreviation for Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A foreign nation could assist Ulster in an uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: A large South Asian nation.

clue.text: Point to the bad 4th man

parts.note: S is south, a compass point

indicators.note: bad means spoiled, so the letters of the are jumbled

explanation.surface: Pointing out a wicked fourth man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' gives ETH from THE. In Genesis, after Adam, Eve, Cain and Abel, this son of Adam was the fourth man.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible, Adam's third son followed Cain and Abel.

clue.text: The French can speak a much older language

parts.note: la is the feminine definite article in French
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: French speakers can use an ancient tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: The tongue of ancient Rome predates French.

clue.text: Hop it! here comes dad with 500 chopped leeks

indicators.note: chopping the vegetables cuts the letters up for rearranging

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for five hundred

explanation.surface: A father arrives with heaps of sliced vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: Hop it is a command to run off and leave quickly.

clue.text: Stop express with a well known slogan

parts.note: to catch a ball is to stop it
to phrase something is to express it in words

explanation.surface: Halting an express train with a famous motto.
explanation.definitionFit: A saying everyone repeats becomes a popular slogan.
